text:
marie (PM): quick sync: i've uploaded a new invite + roles panel iteration to figma — aiming to resolve three items before next Beta: 1) action affordances in dense view (hover vs persistent), 2) where the SSO enforcement toggle lives (header banner vs org settings), 3) faster access to audit entries (we're prototyping an 'Audit Finder' quickopen). link: https://www.figma.com/file/wxyz9876

devin (Designer): looked it over. i'm pushing a denser rows option (6 rows visible) with smaller role chips. main hesitation: removing persistent controls to save space — users miss discoverability. low-contrast icons always visible feels safer.

sam (Frontend): fyi, making action buttons appear only on hover caused a reflow in Safari when the width changed. we can mitigate with fixed-width action column, but that eats layout space. micro-kebab (always present, low opacity) seems easiest.

ellie (Eng-ML): accessibility impact: hover-only = keyboard inaccessible. if we go micro-kebab, ensure it's focusable and has aria-label like "Row actions for <username/org>". role chips need `aria-pressed` when used as toggles and readable labels: e.g., "Role: DevOps, active".

jordan (Support): dev note from tickets — two customers asked where audit events were after recent UI churn. strongly prefer a top-level audit icon in the header (eye/clock) that opens the Audit Finder, plus contextual timestamp links in rows. that reduces support load.

devin (Designer): timestamp links could be subtle: small link icon next to time that opens finder anchored to that event. i can mock both: inline anchor and a global quicklink.

sam (Frontend): linking timestamps should be a route param (e.g., /orgs/:id/audit?anchor=evt_1234). will prototype fallback if audit isn't enabled (open a tooltip that says "Audit not enabled for this org").

a11y-bot: quick accessibility checklist: 1) micro-kebab must be reachable by keyboard (tab), labelled (`aria-label`). 2) role grid must be an actual table or a list with headings. 3) Ensure skip-to-audit link exists (for keyboard users). 4) provide accessible name for Audit Finder modal and trap focus while open.

ellie (Eng-ML): also request visible focus states on compressed rows (not only on the action icons). some designs currently hide focus outlines for aesthetics 94 that will break keyboard nav.

marie (PM): copy proposals: change "Invite team" -> "Invite people"; change SSO toggle label to "Enforce SSO sign-in" and subtext "Block non-SSO sign-ins". prefer short but explicit. thoughts?

devin (Designer): like "Invite people". "Enforce SSO sign-in" is clear but long 94 maybe show short label and put the longer explanation as help text below. i'll test two-line labels in the header layout.

sam (Frontend): implement short label + `aria-describedby` with the longer explanation so screen readers get the full context without breaking UI.

jordan (Support): i'll draft the KB blurb for both label variants so we can ship docs with UI: include steps to enable/disable and note on SSO enforcement consequences (service accounts, API keys).

devin (Designer): small pattern Q: should the micro-kebab be left-aligned or right-aligned in dense rows? left aligns with selection behaviors but feels odd. leaning right.

sam (Frontend): right aligned is simpler (matches existing tables). another implementation concern: touch targets in dense mode must still be 44px. we may need to slightly increase row height when touch devices are detected.

a11y-bot: note on touch targets: ensure touch pointer media query increases hit area; expose focus styles regardless.

ellie (Eng-ML): i'll run a quick NVDA + VoiceOver walkthrough on the new frames and post any blocking items. target Wed EOD.

marie (PM): agreed next steps: devin 94 update figma with micro-kebab right-aligned + timestamp anchor mock; sam 94 spike route param + fallback + touch behavior; ellie 94 a11y walkthrough; jordan 94 KB draft. can we aim to reconvene Thu morning? :calendar:

devin (Designer): yep, will post updated frames and notes. :thumbsup:

sam (Frontend): starting spike tomorrow AM, will post findings in this thread.

ellie (Eng-ML): will run checks and include a short table of issues (priority: block/urgent/low).

a11y-bot: reminder: include aria attributes and results of automated axe run in PR.

marie (PM): awesome, thanks all. logging action items in the design board and adding this thread to the sprint notes.
